title: Pure From the Underworld
summary: From the Underworld is the Tour Guide Fiend series featuring Tour Guide From the Underworld, Tour Bus From the Underworld, Tour Bus To Forbidden Realms, Doomdog Octhros, and the Link bosses Muckraker From the Underworld, Beat Cop from the Underworld, and Underworld Goddess of the Closed World. Tour Guide summons Level 3 Fiends directly from the Deck to climb into Beat Cop and Muckraker while Tour Bus recycles resources every turn.

allow.Underworld Goddess of the Closed World: Link-5 Fiend boss of the Underworld series that uses 1 monster the opponent controls as Link Material, negates all face-up cards the opponent controls on Summon, and negates GY Special Summons.
allow.Sangan: Classic Level 3 DARK Fiend passenger on Tour Guide's bus that is summoned by Tour Guide and searches any monster with 1500 or less ATK when linked off into Muckraker or Beat Cop.
allow.Fiendish Rhino Warrior: Level 3 EARTH Fiend passenger summoned by Tour Guide that protects Fiend monsters and sends Tour Bus From the Underworld or Scarm from the Deck to the GY.
allow.Scarm, Malebranche of the Burning Abyss: Level 3 DARK Fiend that searches Tour Guide From the Underworld during the End Phase of the turn it is sent to the GY.
allow.Doomdog Octhros: Level 3 DARK Fiend companion that searches a Level 8 Fiend when sent from the field to the GY.
allow.Dark Spirit of Banishment: Level 8 DARK Fiend searchable by Tour Bus To Forbidden Realms and Doomdog Octhros that recycles from the GY and revives Level 8 Fiends.
allow.Dark Necrofear: Level 8 DARK Fiend searchable by Tour Bus To Forbidden Realms and Doomdog Octhros that banishes 3 Fiends from GY to summon itself and steals an opponent's monster when destroyed.
allow.The Phantom Knights of Rusty Bardiche: Link-3 DARK anchor that sets Fog Blade and pops cards upon DARK Xyz summons.
allow.Dante, Traveler of the Burning Abyss: Rank 3 GY setup engine that mills cards from the top of the Deck.
allow.Unchained Soul Lord of Yama: Link-2 Fiend engine that searches extenders and revives Fiends from the GY upon destruction.
allow.Goblin Biker Big Gabonga: Rank 3 Xyz that steals opponent's monsters as Xyz material upon detachments.

main: Iconic Level 3 DARK Fiend starter that Special Summons any Level 3 Fiend monster from your hand or Deck upon Normal Summon for an instant Link-2 or Rank 3 Xyz.
Level 3 DARK Fiend that targets 1 monster in either player's GY (except itself) when sent to the GY and shuffles it into the Deck—recycling your Extra Deck bosses or disrupting the opponent's GY.
Level 3 DARK Fiend Flip monster that adds any DARK Fiend monster (except a LIGHT/Level 1) from your Deck to your hand when flipped face-up.
Summoned from the Deck by Tour Guide; searches Tour Guide, Tour Bus, or a handtrap when used as Link Material for Muckraker or Beat Cop.
Summoned by Tour Guide; protects your other Fiend monsters from battle/card destruction and sends Scarm or Tour Bus From the Underworld from the Deck to the GY when sent to the GY.
Scarm, Malebranche of the Burning Abyss
Searches Tour Guide From the Underworld or Tour Bus From the Underworld during the End Phase when sent to the GY.
Level 3 Fiend summoned by Tour Guide that searches Dark Necrofear or Dark Spirit of Banishment when linked off.
Level 8 Fiend boss searched by Doomdog Octhros and Tour Bus To Forbidden Realms that banishes 3 Fiends from GY to summon itself and equips to steal an opposing monster when destroyed.
Level 8 Fiend searched by Tour Bus To Forbidden Realms that discards itself when an opponent attacks to revive Dark Necrofear from the GY.
extra: Signature Link-2 DARK Fiend that tributes a Fiend instead of a Fiend you control being destroyed, and discards 1 card to Special Summon any Fiend monster from your GY.
Signature Link-2 DARK Fiend that tributes 1 monster (triggering Sangan, Rhino, or Doomdog!) to place a Patrol Counter on any card on the field, protecting it from destruction.
Underworld Goddess of the Closed World
Signature Link-5 Fiend boss that links away an opponent's monster, negates their entire face-up board on Link Summon, and negates effects that Special Summon from the GY.
The Phantom Knights of Rusty Bardiche
Link-3: sends a Phantom Knights monster to GY to set a Phantom Knights Spell/Trap, and pops a card when a DARK Xyz is summoned to its zone.
Dante, Traveler of the Burning Abyss
Rank 3: mills up to 3 cards for cost to gain up to 2500 ATK; adds a Burning Abyss card from GY to hand when sent to GY.
Link-2: searches an Unchained monster on Special Summon; banishes itself from GY when a card you control is destroyed to revive a Fiend.
Rank 3: searches a Goblin monster on Xyz Summon; attaches an opponent's face-up monster as material when materials are detached.
